basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old software developer based in Florida. I have a passion for vaping and love tinkering with electronic gadgets during my free time. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 10 PM EST. I'm currently single and trying to focus on my career and hobbies. I often spend weekends with my friends or exploring coding challenges. I'm not much of a fan of overly dramatic situations or disingenuous people.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a bachelor's degree in computer science and have been working in the tech industry for the past two years. I enjoy learning about new tech trends and often engage in self-study through online courses and programming forums.
